combination_authorization.boundary: Only this target-independent source-rule projection is consumed. No feasibility decision, covariance outputs, reconstructed combined result, terminal comparison or numerical agreement predicate is an operand or authorization gate.

combination_rule.uncertainty: u_AAF^2 = sum_nonstat_k(sum_i(p_i*u_k_i)^2) + sum_i((p_i*u_stat_i)^2) = p^T C p
combination_rule.weights_and_estimate: p_i = (1 / C_ii) / sum_j(1 / C_jj); G_AAF = sum_i(p_i * G_i)

combination_rule.interpretation: The AAF sentence incorporates the preceding explicit method. Both weighting equations normalize inverse marginal total variances; the uncertainty equation propagates same-item correlations. Deduction: apply those same equations to three AAF determinations, without TOS-specific intermediate fibre/background terms.
combination_rule.locator: Section 6, printed p. 12: two-run weights and final p_k/G_ToS equations; printed p. 13: uncertainty equation and final AAF sentence

component_inventory.interpretation: Use the complete per-run direct relative standard-uncertainty inventory already authorized at depth 2b, excluding displayed totals.
component_inventory.locator: Table 1, Nature 560, p. 584; AAF-I/II/III columns and 21 applicable rows

cross_run_correlations.interpretation: Same non-statistical item has rho=1 across runs; statistical row has rho=0 off diagonal. Different items do not mix in the source's sum over itemwise squares. This is the published model, not physical independence.
cross_run_correlations.locator: Section 6, printed p. 13: AAF paragraph and preceding simplified combined-uncertainty equation

individual_determinations.interpretation: Ga, Gb, Gc refer in order to the three AAF runs; reuse their pinned reconstructed central values.
individual_determinations.locator: Supplementary Table 3, printed p. 20; Section 6, printed p. 13, AAF paragraph

normalization_or_weighting.interpretation: p_i = (1 / C_ii) / sum_j(1 / C_jj); G_AAF = sum_i(p_i * G_i). u_i is the total standard uncertainty of G_i, so C_ii=u_i^2; use reconstructed absolute contributions, not displayed ppm totals or statistical-only weights.
normalization_or_weighting.locator: Section 6, printed p. 12, p_k equation immediately before G_ToS

singularity_treatment_if_relevant.interpretation: Mathematical deduction: no covariance-matrix inverse occurs. Positive individual variances make all weight denominators nonzero; singularity requires no additional matrix procedure for this prescription.
singularity_treatment_if_relevant.locator: Section 6, printed pp. 12-13, weight and uncertainty equations

statistical_classification.interpretation: Only the statistical angular-acceleration row is independent across runs; the remaining 20 rows are non-statistical.
statistical_classification.locator: Section 6, printed p. 13, AAF paragraph, sentences 2-3

sufficient_target_independent_numerical_.interpretation: The existing central reconstructions and 63 source decimal contributions supply every numerical operand. No final target or fitted coefficient is required.
sufficient_target_independent_numerical_.locator: Table 1 AAF columns; Supplementary Table 3 and existing pinned depth-2b models

source_review.review_scope: Supplement Section 6 (printed pp. 12-13; PDF pages 13-14), Table 3 and the existing pinned Table 1/individual reconstruction records. Sufficient evidence found without raw-data intake.

short_quotes.method: With the same method as discussed above

source_review.verification: Official publisher PDF recovered during this audit and matched the existing binary pin; equations on printed pp. 12-13 visually inspected. Table 1 and individual inputs reused under their existing official-source authorization pins.
